tools.name: mot_reliability
tools.description: Real UK MOT failure data for a used car: the share of initial MOT tests that failed, overall and per category (overall and at a given mileage), how that compares with cars of the same age and mileage, and the riskiest components with typical failure mileages. Use whenever a user is buying, comparing

tools.name: mot_vehicle_search
tools.description: Search the covered vehicles (528 UK model generations) by free text. Use to check coverage or disambiguate before calling mot_reliability.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "mot_vehicle_search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the covered vehicles (528 UK model generations) by free text. Use to check coverage or disambiguate before calling mot_reliability.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
